newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up five cents to 14.70 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up five cents to 14.70 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose five cents to 14.70 ringgit ($5.86) a kg on active short-covering after a recent lull in trading.
"There was some good buying at the start after the weak market in the last few days," said a dealer. "But the unchanged level of the LME on Wednesday also brought in late selling."

Initial bids totalled 132 tonnes against offers of 92, said dealers. Turnover was at 102 tonnes, compared to 49 on Wednesday. Buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia. The local premium against the LME rose to $45 from $25.
